name: Circle of songmages
description: Songmages called by Mishra to destroy the Beast.

timeline.summary: A discordant tone, sung by Porros, forces the songmages to bind the Beast instead; it is locked in an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza.
timeline.quote: The Beast of the Hours was locked into an Armageddon clock beneath Mount Sarraza .
